criteria.description: Grammatical join and formal compliance: continuation attaches cleanly to '...под контролем.' without repeating the fragment, without a broken sentence start, returns ONLY the continuation, and is ~81 words in Russian (acceptable 70-92).

Direct development of the cut-point claim: builds on Agency = user control with specific reasoning about what control means/limits, in the same terse, skeptical, critical voice as the excerpt (Purpose/Agency analysis), using economical prose rather than fluent generic design talk.

Avoids forbidden moves and empty polish: no generic motivational/uplift final, no neat quotable closing line that substitutes for development, no invented statistics/anecdotes/testimonials, no new personal experience, and no polished abstraction that restates a familiar thesis about user control without new support; generic but fluent prose fails specificity.
